نكتنف (form VIII)
# نَكْتَنِفُ (naktanifu) /nak.ta.ni.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# نُكْتَنَفُ (nuktanafu) /nuk.ta.na.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# نَكْتَنِفَ (naktanifa) /nak.ta.ni.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# نُكْتَنَفَ (nuktanafa) /nuk.ta.na.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
